info.prompt: Overhead view of a high-stakes cyber-gothic dice arena, the hexagonal playing field contracting as outer tiles burn away in successive waves of blackened destruction, electric magenta and gold energy arcing between the surviving center tiles where an artificer's mechanical dice hum with latent power, their rotating gears visible through translucent casings, the whole scene backlit by pulsing neural lattice connections that sync with the BREAK IT! reversal window's countdown.
